groups.stays: cargo and tokei write one footer link twice, comment for comment, leaving support as the only other witness -- and the three share a transition with its property list left out, which is the half that differs at every site
the cargo and tokei tooltips are one panel written twice, down to the markup and the `.tooltip-grid` rule under it, so mermaid's sketch node is the second witness and there is no third

the same one tooltip written twice, against quadrant's box -- spec/todo.md names `mermaid.node` and `quadrant.box` as whole-box borders belonging to neither named surface so a later count would not read them as members
the same one tooltip again, and a video frame that takes picture's edge by its own comment -- extraction.md has already ruled the clip out of `blockFrame`, and one tooltip and one clip are two
the same one tooltip, and a licence badge: what they hold in common is an edge and a type step, two concerns that meet here by arithmetic rather than by anybody drawing one thing
cargo and tokei spell `tooltipCount` identically because the tooltip around it is one panel written twice, which leaves github's commit ref as the second witness

three of the four are the licence surface -- the package list and two of its routes, whose counts place themselves against each other in their comments -- so mermaid's fallback source is the only witness outside it

video copies picture's border values by its own comment, and the homepage avatar is a circle that happens to spell the same four -- two related and one coincidence, and extraction.md wants three unrelated

one directory row drawn on three pages of the licence surface: package-list's own comment says it copied the row character for character, and spec/todo.md records the two directories writing it the same way
one count on four routes of one section, each page's comment sizing itself against a sibling's -- spec/todo.md holds that surface open at eight addresses meant to become two or three
the directories' own step of the same count, with the package page's version beside it: three pages of one section rather than three components that arrived at it apart
two error shells and a package page sharing soft prose one step down, which is a coincidence of the ramp rather than a recipe
